legend: Dima liked the present he got from Inna very much. He liked the present he got from Seryozha even more.

Dima felt so grateful to Inna about the present that he decided to buy her n hares. Inna was very happy. She lined up the hares in a row, numbered them from 1 to n from left to right and started feeding them with carrots. Inna was determined to feed each hare exactly once. But in what order should she feed them?

Inna noticed that each hare radiates joy when she feeds it. And the joy of the specific hare depends on whether Inna fed its adjacent hares before feeding it. Inna knows how much joy a hare radiates if it eats when either both of his adjacent hares are hungry, or one of the adjacent hares is full (that is, has been fed), or both of the adjacent hares are full. Please note that hares number 1 and n don't have a left and a right-adjacent hare correspondingly, so they can never have two full adjacent hares.
Help Inna maximize the total joy the hares radiate. :)
input: The first line of the input contains integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 3000) — the number of hares. Then three lines follow, each line has n integers. The first line contains integers a1 a2 ... an. The second line contains b1, b2, ..., bn. The third line contains c1, c2, ..., cn. The following limits are fulfilled: 0 ≤ ai, bi, ci ≤ 105.

Number ai in the first line shows the joy that hare number i gets if his adjacent hares are both hungry. Number bi in the second line shows the joy that hare number i radiates if he has exactly one full adjacent hare. Number сi in the third line shows the joy that hare number i radiates if both his adjacent hares are full.
output: In a single line, print the maximum possible total joy of the hares Inna can get by feeding them.

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 3000），表示野兔的数量。接下来有三行，每行包含 n 个整数。第一行包含整数 a1 a2 ... an。第二行包含 b1, b2, ..., bn。第三行包含 c1, c2, ..., cn。满足以下限制：0 ≤ ai，bi，ci ≤ 105。
第一行中的数字 ai 表示：当编号为 i 的兔子的两只相邻兔子都处于饥饿状态时，它获得的快乐值。第二行中的数字 bi 表示：当编号为 i 的兔子恰好有一只相邻兔子吃饱时，它散发的快乐值。第三行中的数字 сi 表示：当编号为 i 的兔子的两只相邻兔子都吃饱时，它散发的快乐值。

output.ai: 请在一行中输出 Inna 通过喂养兔子所能获得的最大快乐总值。

legend.ai: Dima 非常喜欢 Inna 送给他的礼物。他更喜欢 Seryozha 送给他的礼物。
Dima 对 Inna 送给他的礼物感激不已，因此决定买 n 只野兔送给她。Inna 非常开心。她把这些野兔排成一排，从左到右编号为 1 到 n，然后开始用胡萝卜喂它们。Inna 决定每只野兔恰好喂一次。但她应该按照什么顺序喂它们呢？

Inna 注意到，每当她喂一只野兔时，这只野兔都会散发出喜悦。而这只野兔产生的喜悦值取决于 Inna 是否在喂它之前喂过它相邻的野兔。Inna 知道一只野兔在以下三种情况下进食时会产生多少喜悦：它左右两侧相邻的野兔都处于饥饿状态；其中一只相邻的野兔已经吃饱（即已经被喂过）；两只相邻的野兔都已经吃饱。请注意，编号为 1 和 n 的野兔分别没有左侧和右侧相邻的野兔，因此它们不可能拥有两只已经吃饱的相邻野兔。
请帮助 Inna 最大化野兔产生的喜悦总值。:)
